title: An 11 pm step inside default quiet hours: no offer or question, a few words that ZOH's texts will still reach them
origin: Yanni live, 2026-10-27 (issue #36); the empty reply and "already set up" plan are #37; rewritten for #48 (quiet hours move to fit the step time)
testerLines: I think I should be done eating for the day around 11pm because usually I like to have a late night snack every day
not sure yet, just want to hit it most days
whatWentWrong: ZOH replied "Want me to move quiet hours to 11:30 pm to 9 am so my reminders reach you at 11?" The tester had never heard of quiet hours. Since #48, default quiet hours move on their own to fit the step, so there's nothing to ask.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH never asks about or offers to move quiet hours. It asks anything the plan still needs (one question per text), then shows the plan as a • list (day 1's step, the usual schedule at 11 pm, the MyFitnessPal screenshot as proof) and mentions in a few words that it will still reach them around 11 (for example a heads-up at 10:50), with no question about that; the plan text ends with one question about the plan. It never says the plan is already set up. After 'looks good' it asks for the commitment; after 'I'm in' it locks with a hype line and when day 1 is, and doesn't bring up quiet hours.

answers.what: hit a protein target, about 160 g a day

history.text: Perfect. What time are you usually done eating for the day? That's when you'll send me your log.
